verses.ar: فَسُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَصَّهُ ﷺ بِأَشْرَفِ الْمَنَاصِبِ وَالْمَرَاتِبِ
verses.tr: Fa-subḥāna man khaṣṣahu ﷺ bi-ashrafi l-manāṣibi wa l-marātib
verses.en: Glory be to the One who singled him ﷺ out with the noblest of offices and ranks.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُهُ عَلٰى مَا مَنَحَ مِنَ الْمَوَاهِبِ
verses.tr: Aḥmaduhu ʿalā mā manaḥa mina l-mawāhib
verses.en: I praise Him for the gifts He has bestowed.

verses.ar: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ رَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ
verses.tr: Wa ashhadu an lā ilāha illā-Llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu Rabbu l-mashāriqi wa l-maghārib
verses.en: And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, having no partner, Lord of every east and every west.

verses.ar: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ الْمَبْعُوثُ إِلَى سَائِرِ الْأَعَاجِمِ وَالْأَعَارِبِ
verses.tr: Wa ashhadu anna sayyidanā Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa Rasūluhu l-mabʿūthu ilā sāʾiri l-aʿājimi wa l-aʿārib
verses.en: And I bear witness that our master Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, sent to all peoples, non-Arab and Arab alike.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ أُولِي الْمَآثِرِ وَالْمَنَاقِبِ
verses.tr: Ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi ulī l-maʾāthiri wa l-manāqib
verses.en: May Allah bless him and grant him peace, and his family and his companions, possessors of noble deeds and virtues.

verses.ar: صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا دَائِمَيْنِ مُتَلَازِمَيْنِ يَأْتِي قَائِلُهُمَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ غَيْرَ خَائِبٍ
verses.tr: Ṣalātan wa salāman dāʾimayni mutalāzimayni yaʾtī qāʾiluhumā yawma l-qiyāmati ghayra khāʾib
verses.en: Blessings and peace, lasting and inseparable — whoever utters them will come on the Day of Rising not disappointed.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.
